init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed mode for single, multi-GPU, multi-node, or SLURM jobs with PyTorch
init_signal_handler: install SLURM signal handlers for SIGUSR1 requeue and SIGTERM bypass
run_sig_handler: run the signal handler that requeues a SLURM job on SIGUSR1 and exits with code -1
run_term_handler: run the SIGTERM handler that logs and bypasses the signal without terminating
test_init_distributed_mode: test init_distributed_mode to set up distributed training across SLURM or local GPU environments
